name: grp-mcp
description: Drive an Acumatica ERP instance from Claude: read, write, run processes and diagnose failures across the five APIs Acumatica actually has. Talks to your own instance directly - nothing is proxied, and credentials never leave your machine. Writes are off per profile until you enable them, and a clean 'ok' is never trusted: writes are read back and anything unconfirmed is reported as unverified. Runs on Windows, macOS and Linux from PyPI through uvx, so it needs uv installed - 'winget install astral-sh.uv' on Windows, 'brew install uv' on a Mac. Run tools\Edit-Connections.cmd once to create your connections file; it lands in %USERPROFILE%\grp-mcp (~/.grp-mcp on macOS and Linux), outside AppData where a Claude app update cannot delete it, and the server finds it with no environment variable set. LATEST (0.81.0-rc37): where a field lives is now read from the screen's layout, per record type. probe_field_binding says whether a field sits on a tab, where a classic write reaches it, or in a dialog, where a classic write quietly does nothing. It used to look for the field's own editor and read its absence as a dialog; measured against a stock 2026R1 site's page layout, that was wrong often - two screens with dialogs were reported as having none, and a dialog's field could come back as a tab field, the silent no-op it exists to prevent. It now finds every dialog on a page and places each field by the record it belongs to: none of 3,701 fields wrong, and 'unknown' where the page cannot say. Also: a screen whose modern layout fails to load no longer reports nothing at risk; a settings record with no OData route is verified through the classic screen instead of reported unproven; and an import repoint is refused up front where no classic page is served. Full history in docs/CHANGELOG.md.
